description:
Albuquerque, 1964. A child is born to a teenage mom and a father who vanished. Fifty years later, that child is the richest man in modern history.

This is the true story of Jeff Bezos, the adopted kid who built the Everything Store. From a door-desk in a garage to the "Constitution of the Internet" (AWS), Amazon wasn't just a startup... it was a siege on retail. Fueled by data, "Day 1" paranoia, and ruthless efficiency.
